name: Eddies Civ Mod
description: A civilization mod: found towns around a town hall, claim land, vote on laws and constitutions, elect mayors and parliaments with real voting systems, form parties, states and nations, run companies that produce goods and trade on a stock exchange, take each other to court, and let villagers live, work and vote as citizens. Includes a web map, newspapers, contracts, mail and an in-game handbook. Install on server and client.
